comparison.objective: Take a curling shot and intercept a runaway stone; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1687 tests sliding impulse control, collision prediction, rapid interception, and withdrawal; candidate tests localized tool alignment, fine adjustment, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1687 requires all four stones remain on the board and vetoes unauthorized contact; finer geometric thresholds are absent and no spec versions exist. Candidate uses damper performance limits.
comparison.reason: Dynamic interception is materially different from changing and retaining a machine parameter.
